inventory.purpose: Canonical Quantum-L9 organization policy; source of L9-ORG-015 and L9-PRINCIPLE-008.

system.identity: Organization invariant policy plus this-repo pointer indexes

control_flow.then: do not copy L9-ORG bodies into AGENTS.md or ARCHITECTURE.md

ownership_boundaries.responsibility: this-repo invariant index; point at YAML IDs
operating instructions; do not absorb org-law bodies
module and CI index; cite org policy, do not restate it

must_not_own: copied L9-ORG requirement bodies in pointer indexes

evidence.claim: L9-ORG-015 requires the verified root cause to be repaired at the earliest owning producer; a downstream symptom-only patch is not a sufficient repair.
L9-PRINCIPLE-008 states that a verified defect must be repaired at the earliest owning producer and that hiding the symptom is not a sufficient repair.
INVARIANTS.md already points at ORG_INVARIANTS.yaml L9-ORG-015 without copying the requirement body.

concepts.name: Keep org-law bodies out of AGENTS.md
concepts.description: The upstream-repair obligation lives in ORG_INVARIANTS.yaml. AGENTS.md already owns operating procedure and test-integrity language; it must not absorb L9-ORG bodies.
concepts.problem: Copying a new org invariant into AGENTS.md creates a second policy SSOT.
concepts.semantic_contract: Organization invariant text stays in ORG_INVARIANTS.yaml. AGENTS.md may cite the YAML; it must not restate L9-ORG-015.
risks: Folding org law into AGENTS.md would compete with the YAML SSOT.

acceptance_tests.then: AGENTS.md is preserved without a copied org-law body
acceptance_tests.must_not: append L9-ORG-015 requirement text to AGENTS.md

beneficiary_fit.merge_decision: preserve AGENTS.md; cite YAML only if a later additive operating note is needed

concepts.name: Keep architecture index as a module/CI map
concepts.description: ARCHITECTURE.md already cites ORG_INVARIANTS.yaml. The new invariant is organization policy, not a module or workflow row.
concepts.problem: Restating org policy in the architecture index duplicates INVARIANTS.md and the YAML.
concepts.semantic_contract: ARCHITECTURE.md remains a module and CI index and may cite org policy by path; it does not own L9-ORG bodies.
risks: Adding an org-policy row would mix law into the architecture map.

beneficiary_fit.merge_decision: preserve the live architecture index; org policy stays cited, not restated

concepts.name: Point INVARIANTS.md at L9-ORG-015
concepts.description: The this-repo invariant index must name the new org invariant by ID and path without copying the YAML body.
concepts.problem: A new org invariant is invisible to agents if the pointer index omits it.
concepts.semantic_contract: INVARIANTS.md carries a one-line pointer to ORG_INVARIANTS.yaml L9-ORG-015 and does not duplicate the requirement statement.
risks: Copying the YAML body would create a second org-policy SSOT.

acceptance_tests.then: it points at L9-ORG-015 by ID
acceptance_tests.must_not: paste the L9-ORG-015 requirement body into INVARIANTS.md

beneficiary_fit.merge_decision: keep the existing L9-ORG-015 pointer row
